notes.title: Flat Path Update 1.2
notes.content:
'Spacebar' to confirm (as Enter).
Gamepad support.
Links to social network.
Speedrun closed until level 15.
Best time in speedrun (saved and displayed in menu).
Saves is now in GCBT format.
Volume sliders.
Calibration gamepad.
Encryption saves.
Control description.
Color correction 'Night mode'.
Achievements.
